goal: Iske baad aap bata sakte hain ke memory numbered bytes ki ek row hai, variable ka address lene ke liye & use kar sakte hain, aur sizeof se pata laga sakte hain ke koi type ya variable kitne bytes leta hai.
warmup: Ek lambi gali ka tasawwur karein jis mein ek jaisi dukanein hain, har ek ka ghar ka number hai: 1, 2, 3, 4 wagaira. Agar aap ko dukaan dhoondni ho to bas us ka number chahiye. Computer ki memory bhi aisi hi hai. Yeh bohat lambi row hai chhote chhote boxes ki jinhein bytes kehte hain, aur har byte ka apna number hota hai. Us number ko address kehte hain. Chhoti dukaan (char) ek ghar mein aa jati hai. Badi dukaan (int) ek doosre ke saath jude chaar ghar leti hai.
definition: RAM bytes ki ek lambi row hai. Har byte ka ek unique number hota hai jisay uska address kehte hain. Jab aap int age = 20; likhte hain to computer ek ke baad ek 4 bytes reserve karta hai, pehle byte ka address yaad rakhta hai, usay age ka naam deta hai, aur wahan 20 store kar deta hai. To har variable ki do cheezein hoti hain: value (box ke andar kya hai) aur address (box kahan hai). Address-of operator & address deta hai: &age. sizeof operator bytes ki ginti deta hai: sizeof(int) 4 hota hai.
howItWorks: Visualize tab mein memory ki tasweer dekhein. Har variable ek box hai. Box ke neeche uska address nazar aata hai. Addresses hexadecimal (base 16) mein likhe jate hain aur aage 0x laga hota hai, jaise 0x1000. Aap ko hexadecimal mein hisab nahi karna, bas yeh dekhna hai ke woh number wahi hai jahan se box shuru hota hai. Box ka size type par depend karta hai: char 1 byte, int 4 bytes, double 8 bytes. Isi liye do ints jo ek ke saath declare hon, unke addresses 4 ke faasle par hote hain, jaise 0x1000 aur 0x1004. Array bas ek hi type ke kai boxes hain jo saath saath rakhe hon, to uske elements sizeof(type) bytes ke faasle par hote hain. Zaroori baat: cout << &age; se jo asli address print hota hai woh har computer par aur aksar har run par alag hota hai. Is liye exams mein aur hamare programs mein hum sizeof, addresses ka farq, ya &a == &a jaise comparisons print karte hain, aur tasweerein banate waqt 0x1000 jaise farzi addresses use karte hain.
